items.exampleEn: This TV show is fun and educational.
items.exampleZh: 這個電視節目有趣又有教育意義。

items.exampleEn: This book explains scientific ideas in a simple way.
items.exampleZh: 這本書用簡單的方式解釋科學概念。

items.exampleEn: The teacher's explanation was very clear.
We had a big party when my brother graduated.
items.exampleZh: 我哥哥畢業時，我們辦了一場大派對。

items.exampleEn: The computer showed an error message.
items.exampleZh: 電腦顯示了一則錯誤訊息。

items.exampleEn: Please write a short essay about your family.
items.exampleZh: 請寫一篇關於你家人的短文。

items.exampleEn: Don't mix these two chemical cleaners.
items.exampleZh: 不要把這兩種化學清潔劑混在一起。

items.sentenceEn: She graduated from high school last year.

items.audioEn: The museum has a scientific show for kids every Sunday.
items.audioZh: 博物館每週日都有一場給孩子看的科學表演。

items.sentenceEn: I don't understand the meaning of this story.
items.sentenceZh: 我不懂這個故事的意思。

items.sentenceEn: My essay has a few small errors.
items.sentenceZh: 我的短文有幾個小錯誤。

items.stemEn: Your answer is wrong. There is an ____ in the third line.
items.stemZh: 你的答案錯了，第三行有一個錯誤。

items.stemEn: After four years at university, she will ____ in June.
items.stemZh: 讀了四年大學後，她將在六月畢業。

items.passageEn: Next month, Kevin will graduate from university. Before that, he had to write a long essay about clean water. He did scientific tests on water from a river near a factory and found chemical problems. He also made an educational video about it for children. His teacher liked the essay, but she found one small error in a chart. After he graduates, he wants to work for a water company.
items.passageZh: Kevin 下個月就要大學畢業了。在那之前，他得寫一篇關於乾淨用水的長篇報告。他對工廠附近一條河的河水做了科學檢驗，發現了化學方面的問題。他也為小朋友拍了一支關於這件事的教育影片。老師很喜歡這篇報告，不過她在一張圖表裡發現了一個小錯誤。畢業後，他想去自來水公司工作。

questions.questionZh: 老師對他的報告怎麼說？

items.promptZh: 謝謝你的解釋，我現在懂了。
referenceEn: Thank you for your explanation. I understand now.
Thanks for the explanation. Now I understand.
rubricZh: 「解釋」用名詞 explanation（例如 thank you for your explanation）
「我現在懂了」可寫例如 I understand now、Now I understand、I get it now

items.instructionZh: 用 meaning 造一個句子，問或說明某樣東西的意思（例如名字或標誌）。
referenceEn: What is the meaning of your name?
I asked my teacher about the meaning of this sign.
rubricZh: meaning 表示「意思；意義」（例如 the meaning of your name）
問句可寫例如 What is the meaning of…?

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第②關："His teacher said the essay was educational" 不自然：educational 是「有教育意義的」，老師評學生報告時不會這樣說（像在評教材）；建議改成 interesting／useful，或讓 educational 用在別處（如介紹給小朋友看的影片）。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "Next month, Kevin will graduate from university. Before that, he had to write a long essay about clean water. He did scientific tests on water from a river near a factory and found chemical problems. He also made an educational video about it for children. His teacher liked the essay, but she found one small error in a chart. After he graduates, he wants to work for a water company."（原 "Next month, Kevin will graduate from university. Before that, he must write a long essay about clean water. He did scientific tests on water from a river near a factory and found chemical problems. His teacher said the essay was educational, but she found one small error in a chart. Then he wants to work for a water company."）；另一條第②關：Then＋現在式承接不順；第③關：還「必須寫」的報告老師卻已評過（時序矛盾）。改為 had to write、After he graduates；educational 改用在給小朋友看的影片

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：中譯配合英文修改
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "Kevin 下個月就要大學畢業了。在那之前，他得寫一篇關於乾淨用水的長篇報告。他對工廠附近一條河的河水做了科學檢驗，發現了化學方面的問題。他也為小朋友拍了一支關於這件事的教育影片。老師很喜歡這篇報告，不過她在一張圖表裡發現了一個小錯誤。畢業後，他想去自來水公司工作。"（原 "Kevin 下個月就要大學畢業了。在那之前，他必須寫一篇關於乾淨用水的長篇報告。他對工廠附近一條河的河水做了科學檢驗，發現了化學方面的問題。老師說這篇報告很有教育意義，不過她在一張圖表裡發現了一個小錯誤。之後他想去自來水公司工作。"）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第②關：正解選項明顯是最長的一個（「很有教育意義，但圖表有一個小錯誤」16 字 vs 5 字），違反「正解不落在最長集合」；應縮短正解或加長干擾項。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 ["內容太短，要再加長","很喜歡，但圖表有錯","題目不對，要全部重寫"]（原 ["寫得太短了","很有教育意義，但圖表有一個小錯誤","要全部重寫"]）；短文改寫後正解改為「很喜歡，但圖表有錯」；長度另由全級名次分布規則處理

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長裁示：正解長度名次分布：a2-u17-l03-q10 目標第 1 長、消除單題異常值（改了選項 2、3）
